mapper.select: SELECT mv.id, m.challenge_id as challengeId, CASE WHEN m.status = 'VOTE' THEN TO_CHAR(m.location) ELSE 'MEETING_ATTENDANCE' END as type, m.title as title, m.description as description, CASE WHEN m.status = 'VOTE' THEN TO_CHAR(m.agenda) ELSE m.id END as targetId, mv.meeting_id as meetingId, mv.status, m.created_by as createdBy, mv.expires_at as deadline, mv.created_at as createdAt, mv.closed_at as completedAt, mv.required_count as requiredCount FROM woorido.meeting_votes mv JOIN woorido.meetings m ON mv.meeting_id = m.id WHERE mv.id = #{id}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM woorido.meeting_vote_records WHERE meeting_vote_id = #{voteId} AND choice = 'AGREE') as AGREE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM woorido.meeting_vote_records WHERE meeting_vote_id = #{voteId} AND choice = 'DISAGREE') as DISAGREE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM woorido.meeting_vote_records WHERE meeting_vote_id = #{voteId}) as TOTAL FROM DUAL
